final_formulations.manufacturing_process: Stage 1: Pre-mix protein isolates and dry functional powders in ribbon blender. | Stage 2: Warm binder syrup and lipid matrix to 50-55°C, blend into dry mix to form cohesive dough. | Stage 3: Slit extrusion and rolling into uniform slab geometry with ambient cooling conveyor. | Stage 4: Precision guillotine cut into bar portions, nitrogen-flush flow wrap with moisture barrier.
